original_target.title: Decidability of zeros in integer linear recurrences

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original arbitrary-order nonsingular integer recurrence with repeated roots allowed, asks an unconditional total zero-emptiness decider. Luca–Ouaknine–Worrell Theorem4.3 explicitly assumes strengthened Cramer prime-gap Conjecture4.2 to bound large zeros. Current low-order and supplied-horizon algorithms, positive-characteristic results, and density-one statements do not give a halting negative answer for all original inputs. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
